title: ligustrum sinense var. chayuense
intro: Ligustrum sinense var. chayuense, commonly known as Chinese Privet, is a plant species within the Oleaceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving cough and asthma symptoms, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Ligustrum sinense var. chayuense include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
